test_title: Delhi Police Constable (Executive) 2023 - GK/CA (Held on: 20 Nov, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: gk
question: Under ‘Atal Beemit Vyakti Kalyan Yojana’, up to how much per cent of average wages is provided as payment relief which is payable up to maximum 90 days of unemployment?
solution:
The correct answer is__** 50%**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Atal Beemit Vyakti Kalyan Yojana** was extended by the Government of India for a period of two years from July 2022 to June 2024.
 
• Under the **Atal Beemit Vyakti Kalyan Yojana (ABVKY), the payment relief is 50% of the average per day earnings of the insured person**
 
• This** scheme is aimed a**t providing financial assistance to unemployed individuals who have lost their jobs due to various reasons.
 
• The scheme is implemented by the Employees' State Insurance Corporation (ESIC) and provides relief to workers covered under the ESI scheme.
 
• Under this scheme, eligible unemployed individuals receive a** cash benefit for up to 90 day**s during their unemployment period.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Atal Beemit Vyakti Kalyan Yojana** was initially introduced in 2018 as a pilot scheme for two years.
 
• The scheme was extended for the first time from July 2020 to June 2022 before the latest extension.
 
• To avail the benefits, the unemployed individual must have been in insurable employment for a minimum of two years.
 
• The individual must have contributed to the ESI scheme for at least 78 days in each of the four contribution periods immediately preceding the unemployment.
 
• This scheme is part of the government’s efforts to provide social security to workers in the organized sector.
